profile_text.body:
PegaSystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA, with CIK 0001013857. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. It states that it has served large organizations since 1983.

The site presents Infinity 26 as Pega's latest platform release, intended to help enterprises build, orchestrate, and scale AI with predictability, control, and measurable value. It describes AI agents that operate with context, compliance, and human oversight, and refers to orchestrating an "agentic workforce" end to end. Pega Platform is described as unifying AI for mission-critical work, and Pega Blueprint is described as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together with governance and best practices.

The held record lists no products, no MCP servers, and no individual lawsuits for the company. It records legal exposure against Massachusetts with a count of 187.
